import { Inject, Injectable, Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ClientProxy, ClientsModule, Transport } from '@nestjs/microservices';

const BILLING_CLIENT = 'BILLING_CLIENT';

@Injectable()
class BillingPublisher {
  constructor(@Inject(BILLING_CLIENT) private readonly client: ClientProxy) {}

  // D0_CASE:microservices-producer-only-billing
  charge(invoiceId: string): void {
    this.client.emit('billing.charge', { invoiceId });
  }
}

@Module({
  imports: [ClientsModule.register([{ name: BILLING_CLIENT, transport: Transport.KAFKA }])],
  providers: [BillingPublisher],
})
class BillingProducerModule {}

const __D0_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__ = (() => {
  throw new Error('D0 Nest microservices fixture must never execute: producer-only');
})();
void __D0_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__;
